newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Anadarko to survey its Eritrea block - MEES.
newsitem.headline: Anadarko to survey its Eritrea block - MEES.

text.p: Anadarko Petroleum Corp is to soon survey its block offshore Eritrea, near islands disputed by the African country and Yemen, and plans to start drilling, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) said on Monday.

MEES said the Houston-based company "has informed MEES that it intends to begin a 7,000 km seismic survey in October or November in its Zula block in offshore Eritrea. Further plans call for the drilling of one or two wells sometime in 1997".

MEES said Anadarko last spring conducted a 20,000 km aerial gravity and magnetic survey over the 6.7 million acre offshore block, located in the southern Red Sea near the Hanish islands, at the centre of a sovereignty row between Yemen and Eritrea.
Diplomats told Reuters earlier this year that Anadarko signed a deal with Eritrea last September to invest at least $28.5 million for oil and gas exploration in the block in the next seven years.
